postings.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
postings.description:
Hadean is a deep-tech company building cutting-edge distributed computing technology that powers scalable, secure, and interoperable digital environments. Our platform enables real-time simulation and training, mission rehearsal, command & control and digital twin capabilities - transforming the way defence, government agencies and enterprises plan, train, and make decisions.
We work at the forefront of defence innovation, collaborating with global partners to deliver next-generation capabilities that unlock operational advantage.
The Team:
dominAI is a close-knit team of highly technical, deeply collaborative engineers — each bringing genuine specialism to a shared mission. We move fast, hold each other to a high standard, and take real pride in what we ship. We work in sprints, building MVPs that are regularly taken out to industry events, integration hackathons, and live demonstrators. There's no waiting months to see your work matter - the feedback loop between building and showing is tight, and it shapes what we build next. We're also a team that invests in itself: continuous learning, honest retrospectives, and a genuine culture of craft are part of how we operate.
This is a new product for Hadean. We're building it quickly and building it right - and the people who join now will shape its direction.
The Role:
As a Software Engineer in the dominAI team, you will build across the full stack of our next-generation command and control platform. This is a system that enables commanders to plan and assess targeting outcomes in minutes rather than hours by embedding AI and large-scale simulation directly into the C2 workflow. You will work within a cross-functional team of AI, simulation, and infrastructure specialists, contributing to backend services that integrate with diverse simulation and analysis pipelines and to the web interfaces through which commanders and staff interact with those capabilities. You will own features end to end, supported by senior engineers who invest in your growth through mentorship, pairing and code review. As your judgement across the stack develops, so will the scope you take on.
Key Responsibilities:

- 
Develop and maintain the dominAI web application using React and TypeScript, building reliable and performant interfaces for complex operational data.
- 
Build and extend backend services in Node.js that integrate with AI inference pipelines and simulation systems.
- 
Own well-scoped features end to end - from refining the requirement through to shipping and supporting it in use.
- 
Work with the team to plan and execute development sprints, and provide well-reasoned estimates for your own work.
- 
Collaborate with UX designers to create clear, high-impact interfaces for complex data sets.
- 
Maintain a high bar for quality through automated and manual testing, in collaboration with QA and through code review.
- 
Grow your skills across the stack through pairing and code review with senior engineers.
Skills, Knowledge and Experience

- 
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience.
- 
2–5 years of professional experience building web applications with React and TypeScript. This is a generalist full stack role: we’re looking for someone who can work across the stack and wants to grow into it further.
- 
Hands-on experience contributing to backend services, not just consuming them. We use Node.js, experience in other backend stacks transfers well.
- 
Strong communication skills - able to explain your work to engineers and stakeholders; quick to ask good questions and surface issues.
- 
Curious and quick to learn - you actively seek feedback and act on it.
- 
Ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Vetted status to at least SC level.
- 
Willingness to attend our office in Shoreditch at least once a week.
What will help you stand out

- 
Experience with:

- 
Frontend tooling we use: Vite
- 
API design, data modelling, or backend integration patterns.
- 
Event-driven architectures, message queues, or real-time data systems.
- 
Component and styling libraries e.g. MUI, Tailwind.
- 
State management libraries e.g. Zustand, Immer.
- 
Integrating with or building around AI services or simulation platforms.
- 
Evidence of advocating for best practices or improving the team you were in
- 
Experience with C++ or Rust
- 
Interest or familiarity with the defence sector, Military Modelling and Simulation, or C2 systems.
- 
An interest in travelling to support customer deployments, hackathons, and industry events.
Job Benefits
We make Hadean an awesome place to work with competitive benefits

- 
Hybrid working with 1 day per week in our fantastic office in Shoreditch, London
- 
Private Health Insurance
- 
Enhanced pension scheme
- 
Enhanced parental leave
- 
3 extra days off at Christmas (on top of our standard 25)
- 
L&D budget
- 
Regularly scheduled socials
- 
Share options
A Place For Everyone
We believe diversity drives innovation and for that reason we strongly encourage those from all backgrounds to apply for roles at Hadean. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to build a workforce that is truly representative of the communities in which we operate and our clients.

postings.title: Senior Field Engineer
postings.description:
At Hadean, we are building the next generation of defence technology. As a key player in the UK’s defence tech ecosystem, our world-leading software is trusted by defence organisations and militaries worldwide.
We specialise in AI-powered digital training, wargaming and Command & Control systems that help users understand complexity, make better decisions, and operate at scale. Joining Hadean means working on technology with real-world impact, alongside a team that is driven to push the limits of what’s possible.
The Role:
As a Senior Field Engineer, you will lead complex defence customer engagements from solution design through integration, deployment and ongoing technical ownership.
This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can take ownership of challenging technical deliveries, work directly with customers and coordinate across Hadean to get things done. You will also help us scale how we deliver by developing reusable architectures and approaches, strengthening customer enablement, and turning lessons from the field into meaningful input for Product and Engineering.
About You

- 
You are a seasoned engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.
- 
You are proactive and outcome-oriented, able to understand what a customer is trying to achieve and work out what needs to happen to get them there.
- 
You communicate clearly and calmly, whether you are working with engineers or briefing military and government stakeholders.
- 
You are collaborative by default. You bring the right people together, share knowledge and build repeatable approaches rather than relying on individual heroics.
- 
You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and changing priorities, while bringing enough structure to keep complex work moving.
- 
You have strong judgement and know when to solve something yourself, when to involve others, and when a recurring customer problem needs a more scalable solution.

Key Responsibilities:

- 
Lead complex customer engagements from technical discovery and solution design through integration, deployment and ongoing delivery.
- 
Design and own solution architectures, including integration points, data flows, infrastructure requirements and security considerations.
- 
Act as a senior technical point of contact for customers, developing a strong understanding of their technical and operational requirements.
- 
Lead Hadean’s technical delivery during customer deployments, military exercises and field experimentation.
- 
Coordinate delivery across Hadean and customer teams, identifying dependencies and risks and driving actions through to resolution.
- 
Work with Product and Engineering to translate field experience into actionable feedback and identify recurring requirements that should be productised.
- 
Lead and contribute to technical solutioning for bids, RFPs, ITTs and other defence procurement opportunities.
- 
Build reusable delivery assets, including reference architectures, integration patterns, deployment guides and customer training materials.
- 
Mentor other Field Engineers through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and hands-on guidance.
- 
Improve Field Engineering processes, standards and ways of working as the team and customer portfolio scale.
- 
Where required, undertake hands-on software engineering to solve customer problems and support successful delivery.

Skills required:

- 
Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience working with complex technical systems.
- 
Experience designing, integrating and deploying software across multiple systems and environments.
- 
Strong knowledge of networking, infrastructure, systems integration, and software installation and configuration.
- 
Experience producing technical architecture and design documentation, such as HLDs, LLDs and interface specifications.
- 
Experience delivering technology directly with customers in Field Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering or a comparable role.
- 
Ability to take technical work from requirements and architecture through to integration and successful deployment.
- 
Experience working in defence, national security, intelligence or another complex and operationally constrained environment is highly desirable.
- 
Experience with military systems, geospatial technologies, secure or classified environments, simulation, Command & Control or distributed systems would be advantageous.

Job Benefits

- 
We make Hadean an awesome place to work with competitive benefits…
- 
Hybrid working with 1 day per week in our fantastic office in Shoreditch, London
- 
Private Health Insurance
- 
Enhanced pension scheme
- 
Enhanced parental leave
- 
3 extra days off at Christmas (on top of our standard 25)
- 
L&D budget
- 
Regularly scheduled socials
- 
Share options

A Place For Everyone
We believe diversity drives innovation and for that reason we strongly encourage those from all backgrounds to apply for roles at Hadean. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to build a workforce that is truly representative of the communities in which we operate and our clients.

postings.title: Engineering Manager - populAI
postings.description:
At Hadean, we are building the next generation of defence technology. As a key player in the UK’s defence tech ecosystem, our world-leading software is trusted by defence organisations and militaries worldwide.
We specialise in AI-powered digital wargaming and Command & Control systems that help users understand complexity, make better decisions, and operate at scale. Joining Hadean means working on technology with real-world impact, alongside a team that is driven to push the limits of what’s possible.

The Team:
populAI is the simulation that makes continent-scale defence training feel like the real world. It fills a scenario with the pedestrians, traffic, shipping, aircraft, satellites and critical national infrastructure that trainees would face in reality, and it reacts to their decisions with the emergent chaos of real people and systems. Without it, an exercise is little more than a map overlay.
At its core populAI is a C++ simulation engine driving the behaviour and decision-making of huge numbers of actors. A custom distribution framework partitions that simulation across a compute cluster while keeping it coherent. A TypeScript/React front end and Node.js services put it in the hands of Simulation Operators. The team is also bringing LLM-backed capabilities into the engine: natural language control, richer actor generation and simulated social media.
The team is cross-functional, with Software, QA and DevOps Engineers, including seasoned simulation specialists. It ships into live customer exercises, demonstrators and integration hackathons to give a tight feedback loop on the work it’s delivered.
The Role:
As Engineering Manager for populAI, you will own the team's people leadership and delivery. You will create the conditions for a highly capable, multidisciplinary team to do its best work. That means setting clear expectations, developing individuals, removing blockers, and turning product priorities into reliable execution. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager and the team's technical leadership, and you'll pull in customer and business context from Field Engineering and senior stakeholders.
This role is deliberately weighted towards people, delivery and product partnership. You will lead the people and own the output, drawing on deep specialists for architecture and implementation decisions. A strong engineering foundation is still essential, though. You'll need enough technical context across the stack to earn credibility, understand performance, ask incisive questions and give candid, evidence-based feedback.

Key Responsibilities:

- 
Own delivery end-to-end for populAI — turning product goals into plans the team can execute and commitments stakeholders can rely on, and renegotiating early when they can't.
- 
Line-manage a multidisciplinary team: set expectations, give direct feedback, hold real performance and development conversations, and grow the next set of technical leaders.
- 
Stay hands-on. Pick up delivery work when the pressure demands it, and when you need first-hand understanding of the codebase and the process you are trying to improve.
- 
Own hiring for the team — define the profile, run the process, and make the case for the headcount the roadmap will need before it becomes a blocker.
- 
Partner with the Product Manager to understand the commercial environment, challenge assumptions, negotiate scope and timeline, and argue for the technical investment that keeps future delivery possible.
- 
Work with the team's technical lead and senior specialists on technical direction, making sure design and architecture decisions get made and hold up against what is coming next.
- 
Shape the environment your team works in rather than just operating inside it, pulling customer and business context in from Product, Field Engineering and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment and support team autonomy.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

- 
You have led and line-managed a software engineering team, and can point to what you improved for the people and for the delivery.
- 
You want to manage. Engineering management is your craft, not the next rung after senior engineer.
- 
You have partnered with Product as an equal to shape priorities and push back on scope, not simply as a backlog administrator.
- 
You have handled the hard parts of underperformance, conflict, ambiguity, and telling senior people things they might find uncomfortable to hear.
- 
You have experience working on spatial simulation systems that model entities moving in 2D or 3D space (e.g. game engines or physics simulation, robotics or autonomous vehicle simulation, traffic and transport modelling, or defence synthetic environments).
- 
You have experience with systems languages (ideally C++) for performance-sensitive, real-time applications.
- 
Ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Vetted status to at least SC level.

What will help you stand out:

- 
Experience with behavioural or agent-based simulation of people, crowds or vehicles (e.g. game AI, VFX crowd simulation, pedestrian or evacuation modelling, or defence CGF).
- 
You have grown a team rather than inherited one — hired into it, shaped it, and developed people into more senior roles.
- 
Experience delivering data-intensive, real-time, distributed or mission-critical products.
- 
Familiarity with defence, military modelling and simulation, or other regulated and security-conscious environments.
- 
Experience leading a product or team through modernisation, migration from legacy technology, or a significant change in product direction.
- 
A track record of building effective Engineering Manager / technical lead partnerships, or mentoring other managers.
- 
You want to be in the room where the product meets its users — travelling to deployments, hackathons and industry events, and turning what you see there into better decisions.

Job Benefits

- 
We make Hadean an awesome place to work with competitive benefits…
- 
Hybrid working with 1 day per week in our fantastic office in Shoreditch, London
- 
Private Health Insurance
- 
Enhanced pension scheme
- 
Enhanced parental leave
- 
3 extra days off at Christmas (on top of our standard 25)
- 
L&D budget
- 
Regularly scheduled socials
- 
Share options

A Place For Everyone

We believe diversity drives innovation and for that reason we strongly encourage those from all backgrounds to apply for roles at Hadean. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to build a workforce that is truly representative of the communities in which we operate and our clients.
